controls.reference: Full binary-string decoding from left to right, grouping equal parts, then set of run types
negative_controls: 45 has four maximal runs but only two distinct types
27 has two distinct part values but three distinct run types

full_scan.measurement: One fresh subprocess; wall time includes launch/output, excludes compilation and controls; os.wait4 per-child usage
full_scan.algorithm: Exhaustive definition-only incremental scan; every integer is visited; composition updated after binary +1
full_scan.independence: Uses neither producer code, minimum-length theorem, nor rearrangement/capacity inequalities
full_scan.limitation: Finite exhaustive verification only, through the stated inclusive endpoint; counts are maintained incrementally rather than decoded from scratch at each integer
